app.legal-content.a91df627c1: One Day, One Thought offers wish records, playful rituals and interactive cultural scenes, with no registration or login required. Wishes are for you to work towards at your own pace.
app.legal-content.6313226092: Your wishes, ritual progress, collections and settings such as sound are stored on the current device. This version has no developer-provided accounts, cloud sync, advertising, user tracking, behavioural analytics or crash collection SDKs. It does not upload your wishes, contact details, location or advertising identifiers to the developer's servers.
app.legal-content.e308ed8727: Basic scenes, the wooden fish model, images and fonts are included with the installation and work offline. The optional online scene catalog accesses the network, downloads scene files and caches them on the device only when a content service address is configured. The network service processes connection information needed for the request, such as the IP address; wish text is not sent with resource requests. The current release configuration has no online catalog address set.
app.legal-content.de0580de4e: In versions with home-screen widgets, the app caches dates, public scene titles, artwork and completion status on the device to display today's ritual. Full wish text is not included in widget snapshots, and widget data is not sent to the developer's servers.
app.legal-content.e89d2ed9ee: You can choose to share ritual text, scene images or public scene links; you decide whether to use system sharing, copy or save. Scene links contain only the public scene, language and visual settings, without wish text. Opening a link requests the page and scene resources from its web hosting service; recipient apps and hosting services handle relevant information under their own policies. This app does not upload private wishes to the share page. Share only content that you are willing to make public or give to the recipient.
app.legal-content.aa3fa15ae0: Clearing browser site data deletes web records. Deleting the app, or clearing its data in Android system settings, deletes local app records. On iOS, “Offload App” may keep documents and data and is different from “Delete App”. Resource cache management removes only downloaded scene resources, not wish records.
app.legal-content.ecb3c759cd: Web localStorage and app AsyncStorage are separate. There is currently no save import from the web to the app or across devices. System backup and restoration depend on your device, Apple or Google services and your settings; they do not give the developer access to your records.
app.legal-content.47113d5703: The app does not need camera, microphone, location, contacts or shared file storage permissions. Sound is triggered by interaction, and haptic feedback can be turned off. Ongoing interaction effects pause when the app moves between foreground and background.
app.legal-content.e0f7865ef9: When you choose to send feedback by email or TestFlight, the feedback service and recipient process the contact details, reproduction steps and attachments you provide. Avoid sending unrelated personal information. TestFlight, app stores, system backups and system diagnostics are subject to their platforms' own policies and sharing settings.
app.legal-content.0e391c8b62: If online services are added or data handling changes in the future, the privacy policy and store disclosures will be updated.
app.legal-content.e4ae3af5a3: Open the day's interactive scenes from Today, follow the on-screen guidance and collect a little keepsake. Wishes lets you record new wishes, add notes and express gratitude after they come true. Little World displays your collection. Me provides sound, haptics, reduced motion and resource cache settings.
app.legal-content.5ed2344f3c: If you encounter a problem, note the app version, device model, operating system version and steps to reproduce it. TestFlight testers can send feedback from TestFlight.
app.legal-content.7497e14f0d: If saving fails, “Not saved yet” and a retry option appear. Keep the page open and retry. If loading a save fails, the original data is retained and is not automatically overwritten with empty records.
app.legal-content.29183a7ab7: Basic content works offline. Online scenes that have not been downloaded need a network connection. Cached resources may be removed by the system or by your own cleanup actions. There is no developer cloud sync when changing devices; do not rely on cross-device restoration.
app.legal-content.0b17f22687: In versions that provide widgets, add “Today's ritual” through your phone's home-screen editing controls and tap the card to open the app. Widgets show only public scene content, not full wish text.
app.legal-content.7cf660d04c: Widget refreshes are scheduled by the system and may be delayed. If the date or scene has not updated, open the app first. Expo Go previews do not include this app's home-screen widgets; a standalone installation with this feature is required.
